verdict.rationale: Oyster's API documents an end-to-end EOR hiring flow: create a draft employment, update job details, submit it to start onboarding and contract generation, then verify agreements and send them for signature. Country rulesets drive the required fields, and benefits can be provisioned. Compensation appears only as read endpoints for bonuses and allowances, and nothing documents tax setup. missing for 10: explicit API setting of salary/compensation, any tax setup endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end onboarding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup

citations.quote: create a draft EOR employment, update the job details, and submit the employment to kick off the employment onboarding and contract generation.
